description: lint_skills.ts AG-005 rules (RU-0018 / Issue #2179): known pre-existing violations grandfathered until OU-002/OU-003/OU-005 (Epic #2178 Waves 2-3) remove them. Delta-aware semantics mirror the check_integrity.ts NG baseline (v2:REQ-0161-005): baseline-known ng/warning findings are demoted to info; findings exceeding a bucket (check+file) drive the exit code. OU executors must shrink or delete the corresponding entries in the same PR that fixes the violation; entries whose findings disappear may be deleted wholesale. Do not add entries without a provenance label and an approval reason.
